page.overview:
What is Slonini Cartel?

The Slonini Cartel was a criminal organization in the galaxy. By 3 ABY, the cartel had collapsed following the assassination of its leader, Slem Slonini, by the bounty hunter Vail Tormin. As a result, Tormin's value increased by almost 350%. Also by that year, Slonini's assassination and the collapse of the cartel was included in a report the Imperial Security Bureau had on Tormin. A copy of which was stored at Imperial Outpost 51 on the planet Tatooine.

The Slonini Cartel was mentioned in an ISB report collectible in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws published by Ubisoft.
